data.name: Text Factory: Automation
data.detailed_description:
Text Factory: Automation is an offline, text-based factory simulation game.

Build production lines, set up transportation between maps, upgrade technologies, craft weapons and armor, and defeat enemies to gather more resources and expand your factory.

The story begins a few days ago.

You were on a mission to defeat the predator. But something went wrong, forcing you to make an emergency landing on an unknown planet

With your spacecraft and weapons destroyed, you must use the planet's resources, develop new technologies, return to space, and defeat the predator

Defeat enemies to unlock new lands.

Build machines to mine resources and craft items.

Research new technologies to unlock more items.

Equip powerful weapons and armor to face stronger enemies.

Finally, return to space and defeat Predator to complete your mission.

Explore 5 maps, discover 80+ items, research 50+ technologies, and craft a variety of equipment.

The game currently supports English, Chinese, Japanese, French, Italian, Spanish, and German, with more languages coming in the future.
